title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description: SENIOR AI AUTOMATION ENGINEERPosition SummaryThe Senior AI Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains global automations and AI agents that support the Engineering Centers of Excellence (JET, Quality, and DevOps) and the cross-LOB programs run by the Engineering PMO. This role turns manual, repetitive coordination, reporting, and quality workflows into reliable, observable, and reusable automation that works across geographies and business lines.The role also owns the governance of the AI skills and agents the organization creates: how they are designed, reviewed, versioned, stored, secured, and retired. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building LLM-based agents and workflows in production, and treats automation as a product with users, standards, and measurable outcomes. This role reports to the Tech Lead, Project Management and works closely with CoE leads, Agile Leaders, and LOB engineering teams.Key ResponsibilitiesGlobal Automation Design and Delivery Design, build, and operate automations that remove manual work from program management, reporting, quality gates, release, and support workflows across all LOBs. Integrate with the systems teams already use (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, observability, and collaboration tools) so automation is embedded in existing workflows rather than adding new ones. Translate stakeholder needs from the CoEs and the PMO into prioritized automation backlogs with clear scope, owners, and success measures. Build with reliability in mind: error handling, retries, logging, alerting, and runbooks so automations can be supported by others.AI Agents for the Centers of Excellence Create and maintain AI agents and workflows that support the JET, Quality, and DevOps CoEs, such as status and health reporting, requirement and epic validation, adoption dashboards, and triage support. Partner with CoE leads to define agent behavior, guardrails, and escalation paths, ensuring outputs are accurate, traceable to source data, and appropriate for leadership consumption. Evaluate agent quality with test sets, regression checks, and feedback loops, and improve prompts, tools, and context over time. Monitor usage, accuracy, cost, and adoption of each agent, and report on the value delivered.Skills and Repository Governance Own the governance framework for AI skills and agents: naming conventions, structure, documentation standards, ownership, review and approval, versioning, and deprecation. Maintain the central repositories for skills, agents, and shared prompts, including access controls, branching and release practices, and change history. Define and enforce security and data-handling requirements, including secrets management, least-privilege access, and handling of sensitive or customer data, in partnership with Security. Run intake and review for new skills created by other teams, provide templates and guidance, and prevent duplication by promoting reuse. Maintain an inventory of active skills and agents with owners, dependencies, and health status, and retire those that are unused or outdated.Program and PMO Partnership Work with the Tech Lead and Project Managers to automate program-level coordination, including status consolidation, dependency and risk tracking, and leadership reporting. Operate as a neutral, shared resource that serves the collective priorities of the CoEs and the PMO rather than any single group. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders across geographies.AI Enablement and Standards Coach CoE and PMO team members on building and using skills, agents, and automation safely and effectively. Publish reusable components, examples, and best practices to build collective capability and reduce duplicated effort. Stay current on AI tooling available within Sovos and recommend adoption where it aligns with organizational standards and needs.QualificationsRequired 5+ years of professional software engineering, automation, or DevOps experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems. Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents, skills, or workflows (for example with Claude, tool use, prompt design, and context management) beyond personal productivity use. Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience building integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms. Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, CI/CD, and managing shared repositories, including versioning, access control, and release practices. Working knowledge of secure development practices, including secrets management, permissions, and handling of sensitive data. Ability to evaluate AI output quality, design tests for agents, and iterate based on measured results. Strong communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and explain technical decisions clearly. Comfort working autonomously in a distributed, multi-geography environment, with professional English proficiency.Preferred Experience with Jira and Confluence automation and APIs, and with MCP or similar tool-integration approaches. Experience defining standards or governance for shared engineering assets, such as internal libraries, templates, or platform tooling. Familiarity with observability, metrics, and dashboarding (for example DORA metrics or quality gates). Experience supporting a Center of Excellence, PMO, platform, or enablement team. Understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, QA practices, and release management. Experience in regulated or compliance-focused software environments.Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this role at any time. Show more Show less

description: Our CompanyBrightSpring Health ServicesOverviewBrightSpring Health Services is a Louisville‑headquartered leader in complementary home‑ and community‑based health services for complex populations, with integrated clinical and pharmacy solutions across care settings. Following its combination with PharMerica, BrightSpring operates a diversified care and pharmacy platform—serving patients and provider partners nationwide—which makes intelligent automation a pivotal enabler of clinical, operational, corporate, and pharmacy outcomes at scale.We’re seeking an Intelligent Automation Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and Agentic AI. This role will design scalable solutions, drive delivery from concept through production, conduct code reviews, support production deployments, and collaborate with business, technology, security, data, and operations teams to deliver measurable outcomes.Responsibilities What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) Solution Design & Engineering Design secure, scalable, and maintainable intelligent automation solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, business requirements, and operational standards. Evaluate automation opportunities and recommend the appropriate combination of UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Copilot Studio, APIs, and Agentic AI. Communicate technical options, dependencies, risks, and delivery status clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, documentation, knowledge transfer, production support, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise automation solutions. Advanced proficiency with UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, libraries, integrations, and production operations. Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps. Experience creating actionable dashboards, operational reporting, and analytics solutions with Power BI. Hands-on experience building copilots, conversational workflows, or enterprise assistants with Copilot Studio. Working knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, prompt engineering, grounding, safety controls, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop patterns. Demonstrated ability to perform code reviews, follow SDLC and DevOps practices, and execute controlled production deployments. Strong understanding of APIs, web services, databases, source control, secure credential management, exception handling, and monitoring. Excellent problem-solving, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience delivering intelligent automation solutions in healthcare, pharmacy, revenue cycle, clinical, or other regulated environments. Experience with Azure services, AI services, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise integration patterns. Knowledge of process mining, task mining, intelligent document processing, OCR, and automation opportunity assessment. Experience designing reusable frameworks, self-healing automations, operational dashboards, and support-ready solutions. Relevant certifications such as UiPath Advanced RPA Developer, UiPath Solution Architect, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Azure AI, or Copilot Studio. Familiarity with Agile delivery, backlog management, estimation, testing, release management, and production support practices. Ability to mentor peers, share reusable practices, and contribute to intelligent automation standards and governance.
